section: Summary of Benefits for the Standard Option of the Government Employees Health Association, Inc. 2026

rows.Standard Option Benefits: Medical services provided by physicians: Diagnostic and treatment services provided in the office
rows.You pay: In-network: $35 copay primary care provider for covered office visit; $50 copay specialist for covered office visits Out-of-network: 50%* of covered professional services

rows.Standard Option Benefits: Services provided by a hospital : Inpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: 25%* of covered hospital charges Out-of-network: 50%* of the Plan allowance plus the difference between the Plan allowance and the billed amount

rows.Standard Option Benefits: Services provided by a hospital : Outpatient
rows.You pay: In-network: 25%* of covered hospital charges Out-of-network: 50%* of the Plan allowance plus the difference between the Plan allowance and the billed amount
In-network: 35%* of the Plan allowance Out-of-network: 35%* of the Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount

rows.Standard Option Benefits: Mental health and substance use disorder treatment:

rows.You pay: Network pharmacy, 30-day supply: • Generic - $10 copay • Preferred Brand - 40% up to $350 • Non-Preferred Brand - 60% up to $550
Mail order pharmacy, 90-day supply: • Generic - $25 copay • Preferred Brand - 40% up to $700 • Non-Preferred Brand - 60% up to $1,100
50% up to Plan allowance for diagnostic and preventive services and charges in excess of the scheduled amounts for restorations and extractions
